units.source_text: 我突然认出人影就是柏木。

en.t: I suddenly recognized the figure as Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 我是从他的走路姿势辨认出来的。

en.t: I recognized him by the way he walked.

units.source_text: 于是，漫长的一年来我所选择的疏远，被搁置起来了。

en.t: And so the estrangement I had chosen for that long year was set aside.

units.source_text: 我只顾回想过去被他治愈的事而聊表谢意。

en.t: I could only recall how he had once healed me, and offer a modest sign of gratitude.

units.source_text: 从第一次与他见面时起，

en.t: From the first time I met him,

units.source_text: 他就用他那双丑陋的X型的腿，用他那毫不客气的伤人的语言，用他那彻底的自白，治愈了我的残疾的思想。

en.t: he had healed my crippled thoughts with those ugly X-shaped legs of his, with his blunt and wounding words, and with his thorough confessions.

units.source_text: 应该说，那时候我才领悟到自己第一次以同等的资格与别人相互交谈的喜悦，

en.t: I should say that only then did I understand the joy of speaking with another person for the first time on equal terms,

units.source_text: 才体味到我阳县于和尚、结巴这种坚固的意识底层、

en.t: and only then did I taste what lay beneath my fixed awareness of the priest and of my stutter,

units.source_text: 这种近似做了缺德事而获得的喜悦。

en.t: a joy that was almost like the pleasure of having done something immoral.

units.source_text: 与此相反，我与鹤川交往，上述的任何一种意识都被抹掉了，而且经常是如此。

en.t: By contrast, in my dealings with Tsurukawa, every one of those feelings was erased, and that was almost always the case.
